player_prompt.intro:
Uliye Mwari {player_id} ({role}) mu mukino wa {num_rounds}-round wa Matching Pennies.
- Kila round, tuma [heads] au [tails] (au [h], [t]).
- Ikiwa chaguo lako linapatana na la mpinzani wako, Mwari 0 akushinda round; vinginevyo Mwari 1 akushinda.
Jibu na chaguo lako kwa fomu '[heads]' au '[tails]'.

message.round_match: Mwari 0 akagueje {choice0}; Mwari 1 akagueje {choice1}. Kuzama -> Mwari 0 akushinda
message.round_mismatch: Mwari 0 akagueje {choice0}; Mwari 1 akagueje {choice1}. Kutokuzama -> Mwari 1 akushinda.

outcome.p1_wins: Umukinnyi wa mbere yaratsinze izindi manza.
outcome.draw: Muri rusangi urukino ni ubusa ku bundi.
